ThePrint looks at how the Iran-backed Houthis, once seen as little more than a ragtag militia, grew into a formidable fighting force, shaping the wider calculus in the Middle East while also commanding global clout. Bantirani Patro also explains why they are attacking Saudi Arabia—from its airports to energy facilities—and how they have remained undefeated despite multiple airstrikes.
